name: CI_GATE_REGISTRY_LOADS_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: CI_GATE_REGISTRY_LOADS_20261107 — the gate registry loads, or CI runs no test at all.
On 2026-11-07 the serving line held 27 malformed gate files (name != stem, comment a bare string);
load_records() fails closed on the first, so check_test_coverage.py died before auditing anything.
This gate runs the test that loads every gate file and names the one that is malformed.
